That's some seriously awesome art you're making. I would probably swap out the clock face for a natural wood shape, rather than it being perfectly round, but that's me.

Bang for your buck? Hit up estate sales. The last generation that's passing on was huge into woodworking, only catch is getting Thursday mornings off, most estate sales start on Thursdays.

You mentioned working your own stock wood, so I'd look second hand for a jointer/planer, a second hand router and router table, a rebuilt Dewalt tablesaw (Dewalt makes some awesome tools) so you're not spending thousands on a huge saw.

I wouldn't worry about the band saw just yet and instead buy a scroll saw, they're cheaper and the scroll saw takes just a bit longer to work and you can perform more precise cuts.

So far as dremil tools are concerned, I've never had the need for one, but they probably would have saved me a lot of time with rat tail files. In this catagory I would consult the internet.

If you're worried about price, harbor freight sells all of these tools for a bargain, but you get what you pay for.

If you're going to pay top dollar for anything, spend it on your blades, drill bits, and jigs. Those items make the biggest difference on the finished project.
